fact: The innermost of TRAPPIST-1's seven Earth-sized worlds — scorched and, JWST found, likely airless.
bio: TRAPPIST-1 b is the closest planet to the ultracool dwarf star, baked far too hot for water. In 2023 it became one of the first rocky exoplanets probed for an atmosphere by the James Webb Space Telescope, which found little sign of a thick one — an early verdict in the long effort to learn whether any of these seven worlds can hold onto air.
